ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

miller_encoding.logic_1: Pause in the second half of the ETU (Z symbol)
miller_encoding.logic_0_after_logic_0: Pause at the start of the ETU (X symbol)
miller_encoding.EOF: Logic 0 followed by no further modulation

type_a_pcd_to_picc_waveform.parity_bit: 1 odd-parity bit appended after every 8 data bits

type_a_picc_to_pcd_waveform.coding: Manchester — bit 1 = subcarrier ON in first half of ETU.

timing_table_layer_3.fdt_listen_definition: Maximum delay from end of PCD frame (last EOF bit) to start of PICC response (first SOF bit). For short-frame (REQA/WUPA) PICC responses this is 1172/fc = 86.43 μs at 106 kbps.
timing_table_layer_3.fdt_poll_definition: Minimum PCD-side delay from end of PICC response (last EOF) before the PCD starts the next request, ensuring the PICC has time to switch its load modulator off.

timing_table_layer_4.fwt_definition: Frame Waiting Time — max PCD wait for PICC response.
timing_table_layer_4.sfgt_definition: Startup Frame Guard Time — min PCD wait after ATS.

atqa_frame_waveform.transmit_after_REQA: End of REQA EOF + fdt_listen ≤ 86.43 μs → ATQA SOF
atqa_frame_waveform.frame_structure: Standard frame = SOF + bytes LSB-first + odd parity + EOF (no CRC)

select_frame_waveform.frame_structure: Standard frame = SOF + repeat[ byte LSB-first + parity ] × 9 + EOF

sak_frame_waveform.frame_structure: Standard frame = SOF + (SAK + parity) + CRC_A + EOF

rats_ats_waveform.ats_size_bytes: TL + 2 (variable; TL is first byte; CRC_A appended)

timing_tables_referenced: ISO 14443-2 §8 — PCD Type A modulation timing
ISO 14443-2 §9 — PCD Type B modulation timing
ISO 10373-6 — Test methods for proximity cards
general_timing_rule: All ISO 14443 timing is referenced to the 13.56 MHz carrier (fc). ETU = 128/fc ≈ 9.44 μs at 106 kbps; higher rates halve ETU. PICC must answer REQA within fdt_listen ≤ 86.43 μs; PCD must wait fdt_poll. Layer 4 FWT = (256 × 16 / fc) × 2^FWI bounds PICC processing time per block.
